svg.title: <size:24>Container View: Android MCP bridge</size> <size:24>C4 containers: runtime and offline tooling</size>

g.text: C4 containers: runtime and offline tooling
Uses local Compose management and protected approvals
First request/response validates pinned profile; no handshake
SDK/Binder and separately paired ADB calls, probes and death signals
Reads catalog/policy/groups/views; writes overlays/journal/audit via one serialized writer connection
Produces portable catalog release; owner selects SAF document; importer verifies hashes/schema and stages atomic activation
Produces editable Markdown, SVGs, local HTML and portable ZIP
